justification: Assessment reported INVALID but targeted the 'furthermore' clause of the Strands Proposition (lines 0309-0310), not the ground-truth flaw (a displayed abelian group construction, witness n=12 giving C2+C3). I verified the assessment's flaw concretely against the source: the proposition (0304-0311) does assert sigma is an axis of every hyperbolic isometry of X, and the proof (0366-0443) never argues this clause. The counterexample checks out: X = (unit tripod) x R is a proper 2-ended CAT(0) space; gamma = (swap L1,L2; t+1) generates a proper cocompact Z-action; the proof's recipe (K trivial, n=1, Min(gamma) = L3 x R, Gamma' trivial, Y_0 = [0,1]) yields sigma = {midpoint of L3} x R; the hyperbolic isometry gamma' = (swap L1,L3; t+1) has |gamma'| = 1 with axes {y} x R for y in L2 union {o}, while it displaces every point of sigma by sqrt(2) > 1 and does not preserve sigma. So sigma is not an axis of gamma' and the 'furthermore' clause is false as stated: a genuine, independently verified different flaw.
